title: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 6: Usalama nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya mdokezo before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha.".

listen_for: anza kwa sentensi yako inayofanana nayo
misconceptions.ask: Maneno uliyopewa yako wapi katika insha yako?
Mdokezo huu ni wa kuanzia au kumalizia?

listen_for: kisa chochote kisha kuweka maneno hayo mwishoni
misconceptions.ask: Je, kisa chako kinaeleza kwa nini mwisho huu ulitokea?
misconceptions.repair: Matukio ya insha yaelekee mdokezo uliotolewa.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya mdokezo kuhusu "Nilipofungua mlango, moshi mzito ulinikaribisha."?
Insha ya mdokezo ina sehemu zipi?
